#schema: # The heaviest gh user in the corpus after /execute: release create, release
# view, release delete, release upload, workflow run, run list, run view, api,
# issue list, pr list, auth status. Version analysis reads `git describe` and
# `git log`, the declared-check step prints `git diff --stat`, and the
# no-workflow fallback tags and pushes. A repository's declared release checks
# bring their own host needs, stated in its release extension, not here.
# Both are independent-cadence, so each is one tool-only record however many
